amelia-partners: FYI onboarding ask from CloudPartnerZ: they want a packaged starter showing k8s inference + autoscaling + private networking, plus guidance for packaging the Terraform modules for the marketplace. Key asks: clear module boundaries, module semver + changelog, small QA harness, and a 1-page ops/runbook for customers. Any objections to a single repo with modules/ + examples/ + packaging/ ?

ryan-eng: No objections. Suggest repo layout: modules/{network,cluster,inference,kms,iam}, examples/{aws,gcp,azure}, packaging/{manifest.yaml,license,release_notes.md}, docs/{arch.md,runbook.md}. Packaging would produce a zipped artifact and a manifest that marketplace can consume.

tess-arch: Architecture constraints: inference must support routing_mode (hosted|dedicated), enable_hsm boolean, and a private_ip only option for control plane. For marketplace listing we should include a small reference deployment (single-node demo) plus an example scaled prod config. I'll drop a compact diagram in docs/arch.md and a table of supported cloud features.

omar-terraform: I'll own module scaffolding and packaging flow. Plan for modules: no provider blocks, module inputs should be namespaced (eg: network_region, cluster_name) to avoid collisions. Add a modules/version.txt with semver and a CHANGELOG.md at repo root. For packaging: a pipeline that runs terratest + tfsec + generates SBOM for modules (module-sbom.json) and signs the artifact with our KMS key. Example packaging manifest snippet:

```
manifest:
  name: redwood-marketplace-starter
  version: 0.1.0
  modules:
    - modules/network
    - modules/cluster
    - modules/inference
  artifacts:
    - path: packaging/starter-0.1.0.zip
      checksum: sha256:...
```

ryan-eng: Good. Also add acceptance criteria for partner review: unit tests pass, terratest smoke deploy in sandbox, signed artifact, docs/arch.md updated, runbook with rollback steps and cost estimate. Marketplace wants a short security section: minimal IAM roles, container image scan and SBOM, and an explanation of any persistent storage used.

tess-arch: For the ops runbook include: deploy checklist (env vars, KMS setup), quick rollback (terraform destroy + known caveats), how to toggle routing_mode, and troubleshooting tips for common failure modes (node pool OOM, KV cache warmup, autoscaler flapping). I'll draft runbook.md and a compact troubleshooting cheat sheet.

omar-terraform: I'll add a small QA harness under ci/ that runs: tf fmt/lint, tfsec, terratest unit test (create cluster, deploy minimal inference pod, call /health), and an automated publish step that stamps manifest + signs bundles. I'll include a sample terratest snippet in tests/main_test.go.

marketplace-bot: Packaging pipeline template created: https://ci.internal/redwood/marketplace-packaging (checks: tfsec, terratest, sbom, sign) :white_check_mark:

amelia-partners: Perfect. Timeline: omar to open scaffolding PR by EOD Tue, tess to drop arch + runbook drafts by Wed, ryan to add packaging manifest template. Partner walkthrough scheduled for next Mon. Action items assigned. :calendar:
